title: Bureaucratic Style and Plain Language
goal: Rewrite bureaucratic nominal sentences as short verb sentences, and read an official report for what changed, what citizens must do and the results.
grammar: plain language against bureaucratic nominal style

items: I can rewrite a nominal bureaucratic sentence as a short verb sentence (*Se procedió a la revisión* as *Se revisó*).
I can spot jargon and over-elaborate phrasing and choose the plain version.
I can read an official report and find what changed, what citizens must do and the results.
